description: National Weather Service Wind Forecast is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This map displays the wind forecast over the next 72 hours across the contiguous United States, in 3 hour increments, including wind direction, wind gust, and sustained wind speed. Zoom in on the Map to refine the detail for a desired area. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Weather. Its keywords are wind speed, wind forcasting, wind gust. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ESRI Custom License (https://content.esri.com/arcgisonline/docs/tou_summary.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
